summary: II combines transitive presentation/advancement and intransitive approach. An l-suffix can denote an approach goal; a full l-marked noun can be an actor. Neither alone settles valency.
Sexual sense 3 is secured by conjugal nights and marriage context; hostile approach to an abducted woman is insufficient alone.
ko-Preterit has singular, plural and first-person evidence. Active Infectum-wa and Preterit-wa, Detransitive Infectum and Part. Pass. add boxes.
The military example 29/14 is embedded in the note on qdm.II.t.preterit.2; it is already present, not a new attestation.
Read-only mqad, šlomo, ǧanano and namus searches found no existing qdm greeting, life or honour collocations.
Existing Detransitive Infinitiv examples denote active approaching; preserve their inherited filing pending structural review.

Transitive present/offer contrasts with intransitive approach even with similar l-marked complements: a recipient in sense 1 versus goal in sense 2. Jan 4.II/889 is intransitive sense 2, not the reader’s 1.
Active plural mqadmiwo ṭarfe has overt agents; mqadmiwole muklo at Jan 2.5/1448 is also likely active, but is not selected because the immediate construction is less explicit.

The learned abstract vocabulary tawədyoṯo, klaytoṯo, falsafe and safroyuṯo characterizes acknowledgements and political/intellectual prose. This supports constructional and figurative distinctions, without deriving them from the machine English.
Preterit mqadamme at Jan 2.35/5527 can express attained advancement; a plural state predicate is also possible. The lexical progress distinction is clearer than its precise morphological filing.

Inherited Detransitive Infinitiv senses 2 and 3 remain filed as in the source, following the unresolved round 1 question. This round supplies only finite Detransitive sense 1; it does not recast those inherited Infinitiv examples.
At JTM 3.1/19, finite Preterit or plural state predicate?
At 21/55, does a person approach the deadline or is the deadline the actor? German and l-marking do not settle this.
Confirm the razor object at 27/39 and shark argument at PrS 41/79.
Verify gə- at 29/514, gmadmalləx at 29/73 and Mqadamlalle at 61/361.
At 96/353, does i kačke belong to the approach clause or the following speech clause?
115/304 has muklo but the edition translation has Wasser. Check the edition; this translation was not added.
Should qedomo be filed as active Infinitiv? The inherited Detransitive layout is retained.
Supply an explicit Detransitive sense gloss for the existing finite sense 1 examples.
At 68/46, determine the referent and function of -a in mqadema.
At Jan 2.35/5527, is mqadamme finite Preterit or a plural state adjective? The progress sense is secure but the example’s box is provisional.
At Jan 3.14/128, confirm the d-clause boundary and whether aʕ ʕitawoṯo denotes the embedded subject or an audience; only one propositional attestation is supplied.
Confirm kmiqadmi plural agreement and m laf agent coding at Jan 3.6/71.
At Jan 2.12/2857, does mqadamle reflect contracted Infectum with object suffix after d-? No additional form is published from the ambiguous spelling.
At Jan 3.14/142, segment kəmqadamme as recipient-bearing Infectum versus ko-Preterit; sense 1 is clear, form not independently settled.
Correct the infinitive after werde.

summary: States approach one another in a political setting; no new sense.
Abstract aid, requests, talks and policy needs extend the existing presenting/offering sense; no separate numbered meaning for each noun.
Reflexive ruḥayye/ruḥayna means presenting oneself, in conscription and women’s public participation; no lexical enlistment sense follows merely from the setting.
tawədyoṯo replaces the original mamnuniye in giving thanks, including public written acknowledgements. Round 1 already illustrates thanking; no duplicate idiom.
Jan confirms round 1 active Infectum-wa, not a new box: physical, military and social approach. Calendar mqadmo i šato is a temporal participant extension, not a new technical lexical sense.
